integrity: Ore's squarefree characterization reduces every exception in the fixed-\(r\) layer to twice a squarefree product of \(r-1\) primes all congruent to \(1\pmod4\). Prabhu's fixed-residue Landau theorem then gives the main term, with \(r=2\) handled by the prime number theorem in arithmetic progressions. Finite enumeration is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The asymptotic holds for each fixed \(r\ge2\) and is not uniform in \(r\). No effective error term is claimed. Ore's 1948 source predates the stored date, but only year-level bibliographic dating was verified for that source.
title: Fixed-prime-factor law for non-arithmetic squarefree numbers
